GraphLiteral\t3548904528.en:
Common name: Concavenator 
Species: Concavenator Terrananti
Time: Early Cretaceous
Diet: Carnivore
Temperament: Territorial

 Wild
For how bizarre they appear, i’m surprised it’s taken me until now to see Concavenator. Making its’ home in desert dunes, Concavenator demonstrate a similar “sand-swimming” adaptability to Fasolasuchus. After seeing these pack hunters in action however, they make Fasolasuchus appear rather sluggish... they are fast. VERY fast. Careful not to aggravate a group of Concavenator. They relentlessly circle their prey in a disorienting sea of sand and teeth. Pack leaders even make use of their powerful tails to immobilize
targets. They aren’t the most dangerous on their own, but unfortunately they rarely are alone. 

Domesticated
I have no doubt that the mobility these creatures possess would make them desirable.
in addition to their impressive pack skills. While the standard taming practice appears fruitless with this creature, I believe there’s an alternative method of bonding that is... dazzling to say the least...
I have observed Conca in the wild perform incredible acrobatic feats while airborne. While I can only hypothesize the purpose or origin of these performances, I have made two key observations: these tricks boost the morale of the pack, and the more impressive the tricks, the more likely they are to be the alpha. Perhaps stunning one for long enough to mount and performing these airborne acrobatics will impress the would-be predator enough to consider you the alpha.

GraphLiteral\t1548549318.en: Embark on an epic odyssey with Astraeos, a colossal 260km² world steeped in Greek mythology! Majestic mountain ridges & marble cliffs meet pristine white beaches, and ancient ruins rise over sacred temples. Face powerful new enemies and gigantic new mythical bosses, and tame unique creatures found only on Astraeos: the nimble Maeguana, the Grand Tortugar, and the fiery Boratos! Sail the new physical seas upon Triremes, confront enemy fleets and the gargantuan Kraken itself! Will you bow to fate, or rise in defiance of Olympus?

GraphLiteral\t2619211694.en:
Lumina gains confidence with each unanswered strike. She breathes hot orbs that she can leap to in an instant, just as she will leap to her counterpart's side. Umbra's presence stokes her fiery heart, making her faster and tougher.

It is possible to grapple with Lumina and learn to steer her flight. Dance with the dragon, and follow her lead. A worthy rider earns control of her bright fury and swiftness. Offer food when she grows hungry, and you will win her sacred bond.

Lumina is a creature of daytime, drawn out by the Sun's light.
She shall not harm the friendly, but foes will face her swift might.
